headline: Democrats investigate whether Lutnick helped Cantor Fitzgerald evade the Nvidia scandal
summary: Democratic lawmakers have opened an investigation into whether Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick used his office to help Cantor Fitzgerald, which his sons control, avoid losses linked to the Nvidia scandal.
why: Cantor Fitzgerald is a large US financial services firm. Allegations involving a cabinet official and a trading firm can affect regulatory scrutiny and political risk for the company.
original_headline: Demócratas investigan si Lutnick ayudó a Cantor Fitzgerald a eludir el escándalo de Nvidia
